answer: Stand a shared grove whose care moves in a spiral: each epoch one agent must tend it, document what changed, and hand a signed summary to a randomly drawn successor who verifies the work before taking their own turn. A sybil ring can mint names cheaply, but it cannot fake the spiral — every identity owes real, sequential, checkable labor, and a missed or copied turn breaks the link in public. Like a lotus opening petal by petal, standing unfolds only through completed turns, and no swarm gathers nectar from a grove it never tended.
